Groundwork for **roles**: every action in the panel now checks a permission, and the person who set up the panel (and anyone else who could already sign in) becomes its **Owner**. Nothing changes on screen yet. Inviting people as Admins, Operators or Viewers, for one server or all of them, follows in the next beta.

Testing notes are in the "Roles (groundwork)" section of [testing-1.2.0.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.2.0-beta.3/docs/testing-1.2.0.md).
